column1: # Original DICE Gotcha, play time 47 kOhm (the minimum: a game lasts about 17.8 s).
# A coin alone (1000 ms) does not start a game; Start (1500 ms) does and both players
# close in (2500-19000 ms) until the timer ends it. Start alone (21000 ms) begins the
# second game the coin bought: the square chases a still cross (22000-38500 ms).
# Start after that (41000 ms) does nothing: the coin is used up. Two coins (43000,
# 43200 ms) and Start (44000 ms) begin a game: the cross runs into a still square
# (45000-61000 ms). Start (64000 ms) begins the second game of those coins (both
# close in, 65000-81000 ms); a third Start (84000 ms) does nothing: coins do not
# accumulate. Rows: ms action value (upN/downN/leftN/rightN held switches).
